cases.title: Seltiss-2 main battery contradictory attack bonuses
cases.finding: Preserve Ranged +2 vs weapon row +4; schema must support uncorrected printed disagreement.

cases.title: Seltiss-2 detachable independent cabin
cases.finding: Parent ship carries a detachable and separately statblocked transport; preserve distinct source identity and deployment relation.

cases.title: Dagger printed drive narrative without multiplier
cases.finding: Hyperdrive present per prose, numeric rate source-silent; navicomputer only stores three jumps and life-support/shields absent per prose.

cases.title: Freefall operator-specific crew bonus
cases.finding: Four required duty stations, each provides its own crew member +1 on related rolls; bonus conditional and station-scoped.

cases.title: Scurrg generator reload and buffer state
cases.finding: Generates one bomblet every ten rounds, stores up to ten energy spheres, exchangeable for proton bomb chute; preserve target-size penalty.

cases.title: Stock vs explicitly mentioned named modifications
cases.finding: Different stock versions and named modified ships in adjacent prose must not silently inherit into stock records.

cases.finding: Store reviewed silence without equating an attack group, autofire option or ammunition with a physical launcher count.
